title: SpatialRegistriesDataStoreV1
description: Schema for map spatial placement registries: stair connections, door locations, treasure chests, NPCs, shops, and inns.

stair_registry.description: Stair links indexed by map key.

door_registry.description: Door positions indexed by map key.

chest_registry.description: Chest positions and IDs indexed by map key.

npc_registry.description: NPC placement and sprite roles indexed by map key.

shops.description: Shop keeper positions, shop types, and inventories.

inns.description: Inn keeper positions and stay costs.
